summary: After voters reject an override, a board proposes zeroing out the library and senior programs, and a second override passes months later.
realLife: Stoneham voters rejected a $14.6 million override on April 1, 2025 by 511 votes, and a finance board proposed zero funding for the library, recreation, the council on aging and traffic directors. After a study committee, voters approved a $9.3 million override on Dec. 9, 2025, the town's first in 45 years under the state cap.
sources: WBZ NewsRadio, Stoneham could close library amid budget crunch, Apr 2025: https://wbznewsradio.iheart.com/content/stoneham-could-close-library-amid-budget-crunch-some-are-fighting-back
Stoneham Civic Ledger, Thank You Stoneham, Dec 2025: https://stonehamcivicledger.substack.com/p/thank-you-stoneham
Read by the local and campaign speeches writer's helper, Nov 24, 2026; pages were read through a page summary, and every description is a paraphrase.
inGame: a failed override result; library, recreation and senior budget lines in the next budget; a later override measure

turns.way: The second override fails too and the library closes.
turns.writes: the speech mourns the library and blames no one

turns.way: The board shifts money from the library to schools without closing it.
turns.writes: the speech calls it a hard trade

turns.way: The town cuts library hours and holds the doors open.
turns.writes: the speech promises full hours back when it can
